# Security Roles Catalog

## Scope

The catalog of roles used in the system, the units and teams they are
attached to, and how a user is provisioned into them. For detail, see the
generated docs `elsewhere`.

This page is **not** about:

| Not covered here | Covered in |
|---|---|
| Personas | [personas.md](personas.md) |
| Field security | [fls.md](fls.md) |

- Base User -- baseline access
- BU Shared -- lets a user see shared records
